title: HYDE · Sessions
description: Per-session charging data read from TimescaleDB (meter_samples hypertable) — the product-data plane, deliberately separate from the Prometheus ops metrics on the registry dashboard. Top-down layout: fleet totals first, then the selected charge point's EVSEs (guns), then the selected session's details. Built around the first real charger: a HYDE PEAK250 — the battery-buffered dual-gun DC supercharger — whose HMI labels the guns A (connector 1) and B (connector 2). Session-scoped panels ignore the time range in SQL but plot in absolute time — if a curve looks empty, widen the range to cover the session (or use the panel's zoom-to-data). Raw samples stay raw in the store; unit normalization (kW/kWh) happens per-row in the queries. Session-verdict panels are live-aware: while a session is still reporting (newest sample under 3 minutes old) they show in-progress states — final verdicts (fully charged, taper vs abrupt stop) only render after samples stop. The charge point / session dropdowns load on dashboard open, newest session first (ordered by last sample, never by tx id — the CS tx counter resets on redeploy, so ids are not chronological); reload the page to pick up a session that started after the dashboard was opened. Mode switch: the `mode` variable separates Live hardware from simulators everywhere. Prometheus panels in Live/Simulation cover data from the deploy that introduced the mode label (2026-07-21) onward — older series show only under All. Timescale-backed panels split across ALL history (backfilled).

list.description: Global data mode. Live = real hardware on the LIVE_CHARGER_IDS allowlist; Simulation = every other charge-point id (internal sim, EXT01, test rigs); All = both. Prometheus series recorded before the mode label existed (pre 2026-07-21) only appear under All; Timescale history is backfilled and splits correctly.

list.definition: SELECT transaction_id AS "__value", to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'conn ' || connector_id END || ' · tx ' || transaction_id AS "__text" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY transaction_id, connector_id ORDER BY max(ts) DESC LIMIT 50
list.query: SELECT transaction_id AS "__value", to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ' · ' || CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'conn ' || connector_id END || ' · tx ' || transaction_id AS "__text" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY transaction_id, connector_id ORDER BY max(ts) DESC LIMIT 50

options.content:
HYDE SESSIONS
Every charging session — meter-level truth

panels.title: Sessions per day · ${__from:date:MMM D HH:mm} → ${__to:date:MMM D HH:mm}
panels.description: Distinct (charge point, tx) pairs with samples on each calendar day (Europe/Stockholm), across the fleet. Rendered as category bars: the previous version bucketed to UTC midnight on a time axis, so with a short range the bucket timestamp fell outside the visible window and the panel claimed 'No sessions in range' despite data. Caveats: a tx reporting across midnight counts on each day it touches, and sim tx ids merge across CS restarts. Exact times of day are on the charge timeline below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(time_bucket('1 day', ts, 'Europe/Stockholm') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(DISTINCT charge_point || ':' || transaction_id)::int AS "sessions" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cars charged · ${__from:date:MMM D HH:mm} → ${__to:date:MMM D HH:mm}
panels.description: Distinct (charge point, tx) pairs with samples in the dashboard range — i.e. metered charging sessions, our best proxy for cars served. Lab caveat: tx ids come from the CS and its counter resets on restart, so sim sessions reusing an id merge into one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT charge_point || ':' || transaction_id) AS "cars charged" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Charges — time of day · ${__from:date:MMM D HH:mm} → ${__to:date:MMM D HH:mm}
panels.description: Every transaction across the fleet at its actual wall-clock time — one lane per charge point, block value = tx id, from per-minute buckets of meter_samples. Complements 'Sessions per day', which only shows dates. Gaps longer than 6 minutes break a block. Lab caveat: reused tx ids merge across CS restarts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", charge_point AS metric, max(transaction_id) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sessions — latest 25
panels.description: Latest 25 transactions fleet-wide, ordered by newest last-sample — never by tx id, which is not chronological (the CS transaction counter resets on redeploy). status is LIVE while the newest sample is under 3 minutes old; on a LIVE row, last sample / duration / kWh / SoC are running values, not finals. duration = first meter sample to last. kWh is the import-register span (falls back to the export register for the sim, which sends export only); avg kW is the mean of in-tx power samples; last SoC is the car's last non-zero report. Ignores the dashboard time range so the session picker always has context. Lab caveat: sim tx ids reset per CS restart, so a reused id merges into one long row. '× grid feed' is a DERIVED ESTIMATE: the session's peak kW ÷ the 43 kW (63 A) nominal grid connection — how many times faster the buffer let the car charge than the feed alone would allow; blank when the session logged no power.

targets.rawSql: SELECT transaction_id AS "tx", charge_point AS "charge point", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'A' WHEN 2 THEN 'B' ELSE connector_id::text END AS "gun", CASE WHEN max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes' THEN 'LIVE' ELSE 'ended' END AS "status", min(ts) AS "start", max(ts) AS "last sample", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS "duration", round((COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')))::numeric, 2) AS "kWh", round(avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import')::numeric, 1) AS "avg kW", round(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import')::numeric, 1) AS "peak kW", round((max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') / 43.0)::numeric, 1) AS "× grid feed", round(last(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body' AND value > 0))::int AS "last SoC %" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY max(ts) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Gun activity — when was each EVSE charging?
panels.description:
Per-minute buckets of meter_samples with a transaction attached, one lane per gun; the block value is the OCPP transaction id. Gaps longer than 6 minutes break a block (the 5-minute pre-charge handshake stays bridged). A gun with no lane had no session in range. Lab caveat: the CS transaction counter resets on restart, so a reused tx id shows as one continuous state across restarts.

Always covers the last 24 hours (panel time override), even when the dashboard is zoomed into a single session.

defaults.noValue: No sessions in range on this charge point

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'Connector ' || connector_id END AS metric, max(transaction_id) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Max simultaneous guns
panels.description:
Highest number of this charge point's guns metering a transaction in the same minute, over the dashboard range. 2 ⇒ both guns charged at once; 1 ⇒ sessions never overlapped.

Always covers the last 24 hours (panel time override), even when the dashboard is zoomed into a single session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(max(active), 0) AS "max simultaneous guns" FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS b, count(DISTINCT connector_id) AS active FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1) x

panels.title: Buffer battery SoC (grid-side view)
panels.description:
Checked live: this firmware exposes no grid-side measurands over OCPP (no location='Inlet' rows — only Outlet, SoC@EV and SoC@Body), so grid draw vs car draw can't be plotted directly. What it does send is SoC at location='Body': the PEAK250's internal buffer battery, reported per gun side every ~15 min even while idle. The battery-buffered signature is visible here instead — the buffer dips while a car draws more than the grid feed, then recharges slowly afterwards.

Always covers the last 24 hours (panel time override), even when the dashboard is zoomed into a single session.

SoC is reported over the buffer's USABLE window (160 kWh; nominal 193.5 kWh, 5-95% pack window) — 100% = 160 kWh deliverable.

defaults.noValue: No Body-SoC samples in range — firmware doesn't report a buffer battery

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS "time", CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Buffer SoC - Gun A side' WHEN 2 THEN 'Buffer SoC - Gun B side' ELSE 'Buffer SoC - connector ' || connector_id END AS metric, avg(value) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: EVSEs in service
panels.description:
Per-gun liveness and usage for $chargepoint. 'Last activity' is the newest meter sample of any kind (idle buffer-battery heartbeats included, all time); last tx, sessions and kWh respect the dashboard range and count only metered transactions. A blank kWh means no import-register rows in range (e.g. the sim, which reports export only) — blank is the truth there, not 0. A gun that reports but shows 0 sessions is in service, just unused. Live connector status is on dashboard-dev.hydecharge.com/chargers.

Guns only: connector 0 is the station itself (it carries the polled grid-side Inlet feed — VWGC.ChargingStationCurrentImport — not a charging gun) and is excluded here.

Always covers the last 24 hours (panel time override), even when the dashboard is zoomed into a single session.

defaults.noValue: No samples for this charge point

targets.rawSql: WITH act AS (SELECT connector_id, max(ts) AS last_any FROM meter_samples WHERE connector_id > 0 AND (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' GROUP BY 1), per_tx AS (SELECT connector_id, transaction_id, max(ts) AS last_ts, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') AS kwh FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT CASE act.connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B' ELSE 'Connector ' || act.connector_id END AS "gun", act.last_any AS "last activity", last(per_tx.transaction_id, per_tx.last_ts) AS "last tx (range)", count(per_tx.transaction_id)::int AS "sessions (range)", round(sum(per_tx.kwh)::numeric, 2) AS "kWh (range)" FROM act LEFT JOIN per_tx USING (connector_id) GROUP BY act.connector_id, act.last_any ORDER BY act.connector_id

panels.title: Gun
panels.description: Which EVSE (connector) served this transaction, mapped to the physical HMI labels: connector 1 = Gun A, connector 2 = Gun B.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(connector_id) AS gun FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int

panels.title: Duration (first → last meter sample)
panels.description: Defined as max(ts) − min(ts) across every sample attributed to the transaction — first meter sample to last, not plug-in to unplug. Includes the pre-charge handshake before power flows (tx 100: plugged in 16:15, power from 16:20). For a LIVE session this is elapsed time so far, still growing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS "duration" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int

panels.title: Energy delivered
panels.description: Register span (max − min) of Energy.Active.Import.Register within the transaction, normalized per-row from the reported unit. The register is a lifetime meter — only the in-session delta is meaningful, never the absolute value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "energy" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'

panels.title: Avg power
panels.description: Mean of the Power.Active.Import samples during the transaction (≈ register span ÷ charging time; includes the ramp-up).

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "avg power" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import'

panels.title: Peak power
panels.description: Highest Power.Active.Import sample in the transaction. Compare with the power panel's Offered ceiling: peak < offered means the car was the limiter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) AS "peak power" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import'

panels.title: Meter reports
panels.description: Distinct report timestamps within the transaction (each MeterValues report carries one row per measurand — tx 100: 60 reports at ~10 s cadence).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ts) AS "meter reports" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int

panels.title: SoC start → end
panels.description: First non-zero and last non-zero SoC the EV reported (location ≠ 'Body', which is the charger's own buffer battery; the zeros the charger emits before the car announces its SoC are ignored). While the session is LIVE — newest sample under 3 minutes old — the second number is the car's SoC right now, marked '(now)' and still climbing; it becomes the final end-SoC once samples stop. Empty ⇒ this firmware sent no usable EV SoC for the session.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT round(first(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE value > 0))::int AS soc_start, round(last(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE value > 0))::int AS soc_last FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body'), live AS (SELECT COALESCE(max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes', false) AS is_live FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int) SELECT CASE WHEN s.soc_start IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN live.is_live THEN s.soc_start || '% → ' || s.soc_last || '% (now)' ELSE s.soc_start || '% → ' || s.soc_last || '%' END AS "soc" FROM s, live

panels.title: Fully charged?
panels.description: Verdict rendered only after the session ends (no sample for 3 minutes): Yes when the car's last reported SoC ≥ 99%, otherwise the SoC it reached. While samples are still arriving it shows charging progress instead — an ongoing session can't be judged fully-charged-or-not. Empty ⇒ the firmware sent no EV SoC, so the question can't be answered from meter data.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT round(last(value, ts) FILTER (WHERE value > 0))::int AS soc_last FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body'), live AS (SELECT COALESCE(max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes', false) AS is_live FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int) SELECT CASE WHEN live.is_live AND s.soc_last IS NULL THEN 'Charging in progress — no SoC from car yet' WHEN live.is_live THEN 'Charging in progress — ' || s.soc_last || '% so far' WHEN s.soc_last IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.soc_last >= 99 THEN 'Yes - ended at ' || s.soc_last || '%' ELSE 'No - reached ' || s.soc_last || '%' END AS "fully charged" FROM s, live

panels.title: Session end
panels.description: LIVE sessions (newest sample under 3 minutes old) show 'Session running' — the end-of-session verdict only renders once samples stop, because mid-session power is always near peak and would always read as an abrupt stop. Verdict heuristic: average Power.Active.Import over the final 2 minutes below 10% of session peak ⇒ the car tapered off, the normal full-battery finish; otherwise the session ended still drawing hard — cable pulled or stop pressed before the car was done (tx 100 ended at ~87 kW of a 119.9 kW peak). Heuristic only.

targets.rawSql: WITH p AS (SELECT ts, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END AS kw FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import'), live AS (SELECT COALESCE(max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes', false) AS is_live, count(*) AS n_any FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int), agg AS (SELECT count(*) AS n, max(kw) AS peak, avg(kw) FILTER (WHERE ts >= (SELECT max(ts) FROM p) - interval '2 minutes') AS tail FROM p) SELECT CASE WHEN live.n_any = 0 THEN NULL WHEN live.is_live THEN 'Session running (live)' WHEN agg.n = 0 THEN NULL WHEN agg.peak = 0 THEN 'No power drawn' WHEN agg.tail < 0.10 * agg.peak THEN 'Tapered - charge completed' ELSE 'Abrupt stop - unplugged early?' END AS "session end" FROM live, agg

panels.title: Grid leverage — this session
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE — this session's peak delivered power ÷ the 43 kW (63 A) nominal grid feed of a PEAK330-class unit: how many times faster than its grid connection this charge ran; the internal buffer battery supplied the difference. tx 100 ran 119.9 kW peak → 2.8×. Basis: nominal 43 kW feed (the live-measured refill ceiling ~43.6 kW on the buffer-physics estimator confirms it). Blank = the session drew no measurable power (software test rigs, or a car that plugged in but never charged).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) / 43.0)::numeric, 1) || '× the grid feed' AS "grid leverage" FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' HAVING max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) > 0

panels.title: Power — drawn vs offered
panels.description: Power.Active.Import (what the car actually drew) against Power.Offered (the charger's ceiling, dashed). The gap is what the session could have gone at: drawn < offered ⇒ the car is the limiter (battery management, temperature, taper). tx 100: 150 kW offered, 119.9 kW peak drawn — car-limited throughout. Plotted in absolute time; widen the range if empty.

defaults.noValue: No power samples for this session

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", CASE measurand WHEN 'Power.Active.Import' THEN 'Drawn (Power.Active.Import)' ELSE 'Offered (Power.Offered)' END AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand IN ('Power.Active.Import', 'Power.Offered') ORDER BY ts

panels.title: EV state of charge
panels.description: The car's SoC as reported by the charger (location = 'EV' on this firmware; the charger's own buffer battery, location = 'Body', is excluded — see the buffer panel above). The zeros at session start are the charger reporting before the car had announced its SoC. If this panel is empty for a session, the firmware didn't send EV SoC.

defaults.noValue: No SoC for this session — firmware didn't send it

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", 'EV SoC' AS metric, value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location <> 'Body' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Energy delivered this session
panels.description: Cumulative energy since session start: the import register minus its first in-session reading, so the curve runs 0 → session total (tx 100: 0 → 15.36 kWh). Never the absolute register — that's a lifetime meter (~1.14 MWh on this charger).

defaults.noValue: No import-register samples for this session

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", 'Energy delivered' AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END - first_value(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE (CASE WHEN '$mode' = 'live' THEN NOT is_sim WHEN '$mode' = 'sim' THEN is_sim ELSE true END) AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND transaction_id = NULLIF('$session','')::int AND measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register' ORDER BY ts
